items.title: Sources: Caitlin Clark won’t return to The ANNIKA Pro-Am in 2026
items.body_excerpt: Caitlin Clark lines up a putt at The ANNIKA in 2025. The ANNIKA, an LPGA Tour event held annually at Pelican Golf Club, returns next week in Belleair, Fla. However, one of the biggest attractions at its Pro-Am will be missing. Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark will not…
